description: Find products in or near a BRAND COLOUR given as a PMS/Pantone code or hex — use for 'a hat in PMS 286', 'navy merch to match our logo', 'products in our brand red'. Ranks live stock colours by colour distance (closest first). Where Sense2 measured a stock colour from the supplier's photo of that colour, the result carries stockColour.approxPms (approximate — describe it as SIMILAR to the PMS, never an exact match); other stock colours are matched on the catalogue colour and carry no PMS. Also lists products that can be made in the buyer's own PMS (madeToPms, larger runs). Printed logos are matched to the buyer's PMS; embroidery uses the closest thread shade. PAGED (default 10, max 50): total, returned, offset, hasMore.

hex.description: Brand colour hex, e.g. '#0033A0' (used when no PMS is given)

locale.description: en-AU (default), en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, ja-JP — localises product names and URLs

pms.description: PMS/Pantone code, e.g. 'PMS 286 C', '286', '186 C', 'Reflex Blue C'

name: find_products_by_colour
